The presence of satellite lesions ('Multiple satellites present': "Present"), extensive vasogenic edema, significant mass effect ('midline_shift_present': "Yes"), and deep infiltration ('Deep WM invasion': "Present", 'Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion': "Present") are all hallmarks of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Critically, the absence of a T2-FLAIR mismatch ('T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present': 0.0) is a strong negative predictor for IDH-mutant astrocytoma. There is minimal evidence to support an IDH-mutant diagnosis.

The metadata explicitly quantifies this with an 'NCR Volume (mL)' of 50.207 and a 'Proportion Necrosis' of 25.91%.
